8 احتسى He dug out the sand from a حِسْى to procure the water beneath: (S:) he dug out the earth for the water to come forth: (TA:) and احتسى حِسْيًا (T, K) he fetched out, by digging, the water of a حِسْى; so as heard by Az from more than one of Benoo-Temeem: (TA:) or he dug a حِسْى; as also ↓ حَسَاهُ . (K.) ―
-b2- [Hence,] (assumed tropical:) He asked, or sought, information, news, or tidings. (TA.) ―
-b3- See also 1, in two places.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
